features.title: Clickable Dashboard Stats
features.description: Quickly jump to relevant sections—like members, aircraft, reservations, or billing—by clicking directly on the dashboard status cards.

features.title: Custom Timezone Preferences
features.description: Choose between UTC and your local computer's timezone in your profile settings. Your preference is automatically applied to the reservations calendar, booking forms, and email notifications.
